rows.heading: # VisualCore Premium 3D Games — Refined Round 2: 500 Candidates, Code-Only Graphics
rows.note: Verbatim embedded copy of the 500-candidate study, identical to the tracked file. Selection research, not requirements. Its 'one upfront purchase, no IAP' business baseline is superseded by D-03 (C-02).

rows.heading: ## Executive decision: launch a portfolio of experiments, not 25 clones
rows.note: Screening record: 500 concepts, 62 criteria, 249 qualified, 25 shortlisted (Round 2). 'A ranking is a decision to prototype, not a commitment to publish every candidate' is overtaken by the fixed launch scope (D-02).

rows.heading: ### Hard requirements
rows.note: Six selection rules kept (D-09): code-only graphics, existing ANGLE path only, visuals embody a gameplay decision, bounded deterministic loops, originality. The '$1.99-$4.99 upfront' bullet is superseded by D-03 (C-02).

rows.heading: ### Top 25 ordered for creative/technical prototyping
rows.note: Round 2 shortlist, now experiences R02-G01..G25 (AC-8): a family-capped selection (qualified ranks 1-184), not the 25 highest scores. Price column $2.99/$3.99 superseded by D-03 (C-02).

rows.heading: ## 1. Market evidence: what is known, and what is not
rows.note: Market context of November 2026 (Sensor Tower, Apple top-paid list, Steam comparables): category precedents, explicitly not forecasts. Not a requirement.

rows.heading: ### A platform-portability precedent (verified from product listings)
rows.note: Five PC comparables with porting caveats; genre precedents only. Not a requirement.

rows.heading: ## 2. Copyright, App Store policy and the danger of indistinguishable games
rows.note: Kept (UA-F11): no reused code, levels, names, audio or art; one distinct mechanic, content structure and experience per game. 'Merge overlapping ideas' must respect D-02; guideline 4.3 many-apps risk eases under D-01.

rows.heading: ## 3. All 62 criteria, rubric and score calculation
rows.note: Scoring method: 1-5 ratings, group multipliers, final = 0.30 x commercial + 0.70 x visual, eligibility assessed before ranking. Explains the catalog 'score' field; not a requirement.

rows.heading: ### Original 50 criteria (all retained)
rows.note: The 50 commercial and engineering criteria with weights and group multipliers. Screening data; per-candidate ratings are in docs/brainstorm/Round-2-Refined-Premium-500x62-Scoring.csv.

rows.heading: ### 12 visual-production criteria (mandatory thresholds)
rows.note: Twelve visual criteria with mandatory minimums (V06 zero image generation 4.90, V08 no manual art 4.90) and gates P23, U36, C12. Screening thresholds only; the code-only rule itself is D-09.

rows.heading: ## 4. Population and qualification audit
rows.note: Counts: 500 candidates, 249 qualified (20 inherited, 229 new), 25 shortlisted. 249 - 25 = 224 fill rounds 3-11; the 26 supplemental candidates complete rounds 11 and 12.

rows.heading: ### Major threshold failures across rejected candidates (a concept may fail multiple checks)
rows.note: Number of rejected candidates per failed gate. Record only.

rows.heading: ### Category balance of the final portfolio
rows.note: Shortlist count per mechanic family (the cap on overlapping families). Explains why Round 2 is not the raw top 25. Record only.

rows.heading: ## 5. Sensitivity: what changes if we trust visuals less or more?
rows.note: Rank sensitivity at 50% and 80% visual weight; scores less than 1 point apart are effectively tied; the selected rank is not the raw score rank. Record only.

rows.heading: ## 6. Revenue economics without ads or in-app purchases
rows.note: Per-app paid-once arithmetic at $1.99-$4.99 ('the only monetization event is buying the app') superseded by D-03: free download plus one USD 1.99 non-consumable (C-02). Text preserved in the tracked study.

rows.heading: ## 7. VisualCore architecture: code must create the art
rows.note: Kept (D-09): Swift + GLSL -> rule model -> VisualCore -> OpenGL ES 3.0/EGL via ANGLE -> Metal; pinned forks stay; no GLES compute shaders or costly volumetric raymarching. The 15 module names are proposals (AC-13).

rows.heading: ### Low-cost ways to appear luxurious
rows.note: Seven rendering guidelines kept: band-limited gradients, restrained bloom, spline strips instead of volumes, approximated refraction, instancing and pooled particles, fixed seeds, tests at phone scale, own identity.

rows.heading: ## 8. Implementation and physical-device strategy
rows.note: Kept in updated form (D-07, D-08): implement everything before devices, then D1 -> D2 -> D3, D3 never updated; 10 hero views per game; 60 fps target with documented 30 fps mode; must-stop list. App targets: C-05.

rows.heading: ## 11. Failure modes and the critical-thinking response
rows.note: Six cautions: a visual demo is not a game; scores are not predictions; sources are not exhaustive; ANGLE cost on D3 is unproven; similar games should merge; no-ad discovery has a cost. Context for AC-6 and AC-15.4.

rows.heading: ## 12. Final recommendation: build only what the evidence earns
